endorsements.quote: If such thresholds need to be set, then they should explicitly consider the causal pathway between the model’s recommendation and the resulting intervention, with supporting evidence pointing to the model as the root cause of the apparent performance decay.

unlisted_practices: Do not use apparent model performance from monitoring to drive decisions to retrain, recalibrate, or update a model until methods addressing confounding medical interventions are available.
Base decisions to update or decommission a predictive model on case-by-case review in partnership between model developers, implementers, and governing bodies.
Validate deployed predictive models against counterfactual outcomes using causal inference methods to account for effective clinical interventions.
Embed postdeployment monitoring into randomized trials to assess whether computational techniques yield similar observed performance across trial arms.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective article discussing challenges and recommendations for postmarket surveillance, monitoring, and causal evaluation of clinical prediction models.
